svg.title: The FK lives on the many side
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The FK lives on the many side” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. Customers linked one-to-many to orders with the crow's foot and the foreign key drawn on the orders side. Below, a direct many-to-many link between orders and products is crossed out in red because there is nowhere to put the key, and redrawn with an order_items junction table holding the composite primary key plus quantity and unit price. Three side boxes give the rules for money, time and status columns.
svg.text: The FK lives on the many side
draw it from memory, then compare
